using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra

function initstacks_bilinear_b()
    return nothing
end

function bilinear_b(loss, lossb, x, xb, a, ab, y, yb, i_m, i_n)
    for i_i = 1:i_m
        for i_j = 1:i_n
            loss[1] = loss[1] + x[i_i] * a[i_i, i_j] * y[i_j]
        end
    end
    for i_i = i_m:-1:1
        for i_j = i_n:-1:1
            xb[i_i] = xb[i_i] + (a[i_i, i_j] * y[i_j]) * lossb[1]
            ab[i_i, i_j] = ab[i_i, i_j] + (x[i_i] * y[i_j]) * lossb[1]
            yb[i_j] = yb[i_j] + (x[i_i] * a[i_i, i_j]) * lossb[1]
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_bilinear_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function bilinear_b_cuda(loss, lossb, x, xb, a, ab, y, yb, i_m, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_bilinear_b_1!(a, i_m, i_n, loss, x, y)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_bilinear_b_2!(a, ab, i_m, i_n, lossb, x, xb, y, yb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_bilinear_b_1!(a, i_m, i_n, loss, x, y)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_i = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    for i_j = 1:i_n
        CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += x[i_i] * a[i_i, i_j] * y[i_j]
    end
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_bilinear_b_2!(a, ab, i_m, i_n, lossb, x, xb, y, yb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_i = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    for i_j = i_n:-1:1
        xb[i_i] = xb[i_i] + (a[i_i, i_j] * y[i_j]) * lossb[1]
        ab[i_i, i_j] = ab[i_i, i_j] + (x[i_i] * y[i_j]) * lossb[1]
        CUDA.@atomic yb[i_j] += (x[i_i] * a[i_i, i_j]) * lossb[1]
    end
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end
